info.name: 🗂️ Portfolio Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the MERN Portfolio Backend.

## Quick Start
1. Set `baseUrl` variable to `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
2. Run **Auth / Login** first — `accessToken` auto-saves to collection variables
3. Run folders top-to-bottom; each Create request saves its ID for subsequent requests

## Collection Variables (auto-managed)
- `accessToken` — saved on login
- `projectId`, `projectSlug`, `skillId`, `experienceId`, `educationId`
- `certificateId`, `testimonialId`, `socialLinkId`, `blogId`, `blogSlug`, `contactMsgId`
